projects.title: Projects
projects.hint: A selection of things I've built

items.pokeAir: Real-time local multiplayer battles: the big screen shows the fight and phones become private controllers. Singles and doubles, full team builder, and rooms joined by QR code.
items.nonameLauncher: Desktop Minecraft launcher with Microsoft OAuth, Firestore-backed modpack distribution with sha256-verified downloads, and automatic Java management.
items.wcDashboard: App to follow the 2026 World Cup: matches, groups and brackets, Google Calendar sync, and a prediction ranking with friends. Built on Feature-Sliced Design.
items.calculatorMonorepo: Full-stack monorepo: a React SPA talking to a Go REST API that does all the math. Dockerized for dev and prod, with table-driven tests and Vitest.
items.pokeStats: Pokémon reference for competitive play: type chart, team and speed comparators, and a team planner with AI analysis.
items.leadsApp: Marketing lead management: CRUD with filters and pagination, stats dashboard, and an AI-generated executive summary proxied server-side.
